channel.title: Daily brief - Martin Jordanovski
channel.description: AI, technology and software development news, summarised every morning. Leadership, psychology and investing on Mondays.

item.title: Daily brief, 25 Nov 2026
item.description:
Tidal to ban AI-generated music from December 9: Tidal will stop accepting fully AI-generated music on December 9 and will delete about 29 million such songs. It expects to reject roughly 80,000 to 85,000 tracks a day. Songs made with AI assistance remain allowed.
Rust 1.100 stabilises the never type after a decade of work: Rust 1.100.0, released 12 November 2026, stabilises the never type (!) and makes Infallible an alias for it. The release also stabilises the core of the allocator API, adds DropGuard, and adds an opt-in dependency cooldown setting to Cargo.
Microsoft declares 'Code Red' after nearly 24-hour Outlook and Exchange outage: An Exchange Online and Outlook outage cut off email for millions of customers for nearly 24 hours. Microsoft declared an internal 'Code Red' after a bug on Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers triggered it, and internal memos describe an overhaul with one-hour recovery goals.
